$comment: Machine-readable companion to IDENTITY-MODEL.md §3.3.3 'Shared DB objects'. Read by scripts/check_shared_object_drift.py. This file is the object list; that section is the narrative (ownership rationale, incident history). Whichever side notices a gap first should add to BOTH in the same PR — that's the rule this file exists to make cheap to follow.

objects.name: field_people
objects.note: Not in IDENTITY-MODEL.md's table historically — tracked only as prose in eq-field's own CLAUDE.md, guarded there for exactly one property (security_invoker). Added to this registry 2026-09-01 after eq-shell's 0249_field_people_view_parity.sql changed its column shape (added a `group` alias, stubbed `employment_type` to NULL) and neither existing guard noticed.

objects.name: field_people_removed
objects.note: Twin of field_people — same history, same gap, same fix.

objects.name: field_job_numbers_src
objects.note: Rewritten 4x by eq-shell's Ops/Quotes pipeline before eq-field noticed (2026-08-26, reconciled PR #796). Was already added to both eq-field's and eq-shell's own hand-maintained arrays; this is its first appearance in a live-diffed check.

candidates_not_yet_decided.name: field_people_worker_id_iu
candidates_not_yet_decided.note: Trigger on app_data.field_people writing cards_worker_id back to app_data.staff — surfaced live during the 2026-09-01 investigation. Same family as field_people_iud but ownership/shared-edit status not yet confirmed either way. Not enforced by check_shared_object_drift.py (only the `objects` array above is). Royce's call whether to promote it.
